name: nanoflags/nanoflags
description: NanoFlags server SDK for PHP: local, deterministic feature-flag evaluation with signed bundles, built for request-scoped PHP (ETag revalidation and a shared cache).

authors.name: Alibtekarat Althkiya Company for Trading & Marketing (Intinovate)

suggest.ext-sodium: Required to verify bundle signatures (on by default for the hosted edge); or install paragonie/sodium_compat
suggest.paragonie/sodium_compat: Pure-PHP signature verification where ext-sodium is not available
suggest.psr/http-server-middleware: For NanoFlags\SessionMiddleware (PSR-15 test-session middleware); PSR-15 frameworks already have it
suggest.ext-curl: Built-in HTTP transport (a stream-based fallback is used without it, or pass any PSR-18 client)
suggest.ext-apcu: Default shared bundle cache between requests of one PHP-FPM pool
suggest.ext-intl: Faster Unicode normalisation for percentage rollouts (symfony/polyfill-intl-normalizer otherwise)
